infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: tarmacked needs your location to record the roads you drive.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: tarmacked uses your location in the background to keep recording while your phone is locked and, if you turn on auto-detect, to notice when you set off.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: tarmacked uses Motion & Fitness to tell when you're driving, so it can record drives you forget to start.
